user_question: Summarize mean elevation for the census tracts that intersect State College borough.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts.

workflow_plan.goal: Summarize mean elevation for the census tracts that intersect State College borough.

workflow_steps.title: Retrieve State College borough boundary
workflow_steps.purpose: Obtain a candidate polygon boundary for State College borough.
workflow_steps.instructions: Retrieve a GeoPackage polygon dataset representing the State College borough boundary and covering the requested borough extent. Treat the result as a candidate pending runtime inspection.

workflow_steps.title: Reproject census tracts to DEM CRS
workflow_steps.purpose: Transform census tract geometries into the DEM CRS for compatible spatial processing.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the census tract GeoPackage from its observed source CRS to EPSG:3857, preserving tract features and attributes.

workflow_steps.title: Reproject borough boundary to DEM CRS
workflow_steps.purpose: Transform the retrieved borough boundary into the DEM CRS for spatial intersection.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the retrieved borough boundary to EPSG:3857. Do not infer a source CRS; runtime QC must verify that the candidate has an explicit, known source CRS.

workflow_steps.title: Select census tracts intersecting State College borough
workflow_steps.purpose: Identify the census tract features that intersect the borough boundary while retaining tract geometries for zonal statistics.
workflow_steps.instructions: Perform a spatial join between the reprojected census tracts and reprojected borough boundary, retaining the census tract features that intersect the borough. Do not guess or hard-code attribute join fields.

workflow_steps.title: Calculate mean elevation by intersecting tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Summarize DEM elevation values within each census tract that intersects State College borough.
workflow_steps.instructions: Compute mean elevation from the DEM for each selected census tract polygon. Preserve the tract identifier attributes in the output summary. Runtime QC must ground the actual identifier field from the observed tract schema.

requirements.scope: The retrieved borough boundary must cover State College borough.
The retrieved borough boundary must have a known source CRS before reprojection.
The retrieved borough boundary must contain valid, non-empty polygon geometry.
The census tract and borough layers must share a compatible CRS for spatial joining.
Both spatial-join inputs must contain valid, non-empty geometries.
The DEM and selected tract zones must use compatible coordinate reference systems for zonal statistics.
Selected census tract zones must have valid, non-empty polygon geometries.
The selected tract layer must contain a stable tract identifier field for the output summary.
